Burt Wealth Advisors Cut Apple (AAPL) Stake; Cutera (CUTR)’s Sentiment Is 1.51 
March 26, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson 
Cutera, Inc., a medical device company, designs, develops, makes, markets, and services laser and other energy based aesthetics systems worldwide. The company has market cap of $699.68 million. The firm offers enlighten platform, a laser system that is used for tattoo removal, as well as for the treatment of benign pigmented lesions; excel HR platform, a hair removal solution for various skin types; and truSculpt, a high-powered radio frequency platform designed for deep tissue heating. It has a 24.75 P/E ratio. It also provides excel V, a vascular and benign pigmented lesion treatment platform; and xeo platform, a multi-application platform on which a customer purchases hand piece applications for the removal of unwanted hair, treatment of vascular lesions, and skin rejuvenation by treating discoloration, fine lines, and laxity. 
Burt Wealth Advisors decreased Apple Inc (AAPL) stake by 21.32% reported in 2017Q3 SEC filing. Burt Wealth Advisors sold 2,019 shares as Apple Inc (AAPL)’s stock rose 12.78%. The Burt Wealth Advisors holds 7,449 shares with $1.15M value, down from 9,468 last quarter. Apple Inc now has $851.98 billion valuation. The stock increased 1.80% or $2.97 during the last trading session, reaching $167.91. About 16.72M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
